title: HATS Agent Template
description: A reusable agent definition held in the Agent Library. Templates are project-independent: they describe who an agent is and what it can do, never where it is deployed. Deploying a template into a project produces a Deployed Agent.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document was written against.

id.description: Stable template identity. Never reused, never changed.

name.description: Display name and the name agents address each other by.

description.description: Librarian-facing summary of what this agent is for.

scheduledActionIds.description: Scheduled actions the agent runs on its own agenda once deployed.

tags.description: Free-form labels for library search and filtering.

revision.description: Incremented by the library on every write. Deployed agents record the revision they were built from so drift is detectable.

examples.name: Amara
examples.description: Blue-hat facilitator who keeps a team on its objective.

identity.visualDescription: poised, organised, warm presence in a tailored blazer
identity.backstory: Grew up between Lagos and London; spent a decade running cross-functional teams at a global consultancy.
